description: §21.3.1 — `import:wasm { ... }` uses a host-tag other than `host` and fires E-IMPORT-009 exactly once. (No manifest governs the case, so E-IMPORT-008 also fires — the two rules are independent.)
rationale: §21.3.1: "The host-tag SHALL be host in v1. Any other host-tag value SHALL be a compile error (E-IMPORT-009 — unknown host-tag; only host is recognized in v1)." `wasm` is named as future-reserved, not recognized.
